text: ②じょうげで　つかいたい　どうぐを　えらんでください。

structure.jp: つかいたい　どうぐを
structure.en: the item you want to use

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says you use it to do the action. じょうげで = 'with Up and Down'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on the end of a verb says you want to do it. つかいたい　どうぐ = 'the item you want to use'.

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: てください after a verb is a polite way to ask someone to do it. えらんでください = 'please select'.
